method: Primary agent visually inspected all four rendered PNG files
observations: Twenty distinct bags in four consistent rows of five.
Plain ochre, terracotta and teal bags have convex pillow bodies, flat heat seals and visible hang holes.
Header and price strips are blank; no logos or printed product graphics.
Open back, upright frame and low weighted-style base have clean proportions.
Side view shows the bag depth, peg projection and separation from the rear frame.
scope: Visual review of Blender studio previews only; actual exported GLB page is separately recorded in browser.json.

production_page.observations: Actual GLB is fully framed, twenty plain bags are visible, the blank header and price rails are clear, and there is no loading overlay.
